claims.description: The root-cause trace follows the synthetic learner and owner through login-bound caller identity, organization membership, profile selection, shell restoration, and cache state, and identifies owner fallback at the headerless profile-scope boundary as the first Person substitution.
The central authority resolver permits self operation and active-guardian operation of an uncredentialed charge while categorically denying credentialed charges, unrelated people, and non-members.
The request boundary resolves omitted headers from the authenticated caller Person, filters explicit selection through caller-bound operation authority, and emits privacy-safe mismatch categories.

The real-database security regression uses separate owner and learner Clerk subjects to prove self-binding, owner preservation, fail-closed profile selection and writes, preserved family/support/billing relationships, and fresh-factor non-elevation.
The supporter fixture proves that a Supportership-only edge remains available through the supporter cold-start read surface but does not add the supportee to the caller's operate-as profile list.

Mobile profile restoration revalidates caller-authorized profiles through a request-local profileContext:'omit' client without clearing shared context, then repairs an invalid saved selection or stale proxy state after the authoritative response while withholding stale authority during refresh failures.

The durable verification record contains the named production-only revert failure, exact restore success, real-database suite, touched-suite coverage, type/lint/change-class gates, and independently captured baseline residues.
